question: Which of the following is an example of a Direct Tax?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wealth tax.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct tax** is a tax that is **paid by individuals directly to the Government.**
 
• **An example **of Direct tax is:-
 
 
• **Corporation tax**
 
• **Income tax**
 
• **Interest tax**
 
• **Expenditure tax**
 
• **Wealth tax**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• An** Indirect tax **is a tax when **a seller collects the tax from the buyer first and then pays the same to the government.** 
 
• **An example** of Indirect tax is:-
 
 
• **Customs duties **
 
• **Service tax**
 
• **Sales tax**
 
• **State excise duty**
 
• **Stamp & Registration fees**
 
• **Entertainment tax**
